name: hopper
description: LLM, text-to-speech and speech-to-text for voice agents and AI agents: set Hopper up in a voice-agent project, measure time to first token on its own prompt, find what slows it down, and speak or transcribe audio.

interface.longDescription: Hopper serves open-source models for real-time voice behind an OpenAI-compatible API: gemma-4-31b for the LLM, plus text-to-speech and speech-to-text. In a voice-agent project (Pipecat, LiveKit Agents, Vapi or the OpenAI SDK), the plugin connects the project to Hopper, runs a 10-turn simulated call on the agent's own system prompt and tools to measure time to first token, and shows the results before it changes any code. After the user says go, it switches only the LLM; speech-to-text, text-to-speech and tools stay as they are. It also reviews a voice agent for what delays its first reply, such as prompts whose start changes every turn, HTTP/1.1 clients and missing warm-ups. Any agent can also use Hopper's voice directly: speak text aloud or to a WAV file, and transcribe audio and video files with word timestamps. The Hopper connector adds models, integration guides, a latency review, speech and transcription, and, after you sign in with your Hopper account, your usage and new API keys. The benchmark and audio tools send the prompt, text or audio you give them to Hopper's API; see withhopper.com/privacy.
defaultPrompt: Make my voice agent respond faster with Hopper
